Text.Text: The experiments are over. Your patients deserve skilled hands and a choice; remember both. You've finished my Emergency Cocktail trials. I have no further work for you here.
These lessons require rank 50 in First Aid. Reach that rank and come back to my counter. I won't send an unprepared medic into that ward.

A crew in the Medical Sublevel is testing unstable mixtures on patients who can't refuse. Recover their dose ledger so I can identify what they used. Defeat six Emergency Cocktail Adepts in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Emergency Cocktail Triage Ward Ledger; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Republic Med Center. I'll give you the Dantooine Medical Sublevel Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Emergency Cocktail.

Here's the Dantooine Medical Sublevel Key. Use 'Dantooine Medical Sublevel' in Dantooine, Abandoned Warehouse. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Emergency Cocktail Adepts, then return with the Emergency Cocktail Triage Ward Ledger.

A stabilizer you build under fire. No clean bench, no scale, no second try - just what's in your kit and a patient losing the argument with their own blood pressure. Done right, it buys minutes that don't exist. Done the way that crew does it, it's a coin flip with someone else's heart. That's the difference you're going down there to enforce.

Use 'Dantooine Medical Sublevel' in Dantooine, Abandoned Warehouse. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Emergency Cocktail Adepts in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Emergency Cocktail Triage Ward Ledger; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Republic Med Center.

Chemists who stopped asking permission. The adepts are dosed on their own product - faster than they should be, numb where you'd hope they weren't. They'll come at you with scalpels and injectors, and if one grabs you, count your pulse, because whatever's in the syringe works in seconds. Keep your kit stocked and your exits counted.
Defeat six Emergency Cocktail Adepts in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Emergency Cocktail Triage Ward Ledger; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Republic Med Center.
You've defeated six Emergency Cocktail Adepts. Let me see the Emergency Cocktail Triage Ward Ledger.
Now we can account for what happened under their care. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists have taken the kolto conduit coupler. Bring it back so we can restore the ward's equipment. Defeat five Emergency Cocktail Specialists in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Emergency Cocktail Kolto Conduit Coupler; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Republic Med Center.
Your key still grants access to Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Defeat five Emergency Cocktail Specialists to secure the Emergency Cocktail Kolto Conduit Coupler, then return to me.

An adept holds the arm. A specialist decides what goes into it. They trained under real ward staff before they went below, which means they know dosage, timing, and precisely how much a body can take before it stops complaining. They will use all three on you.

Because a splice fitting is a signature. The coupler will show the machining, the batch residue, the draw rate - enough for me to prove to this facility's board that its own kolto lines fed the operation. The ledger told me what they did. The coupler tells me what it cost the wards upstairs.

Rougher than last time. The specialists work in pairs and they don't panic - panic is for people who haven't already decided you're a test subject. Watch the conduit valves; they'll vent kolto steam to blind you, and what comes through the cloud isn't medicine. Go in rested. That's a prescription, not a suggestion.

Defeat five Emergency Cocktail Specialists in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Emergency Cocktail Kolto Conduit Coupler; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Republic Med Center.
You've defeated five Emergency Cocktail Specialists. Let me see the Emergency Cocktail Kolto Conduit Coupler.
The equipment is back where it belongs. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden protects their experiments. Recover the ward sigil and end that protection. Defeat the Emergency Cocktail Warden in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Emergency Cocktail Fractured Ward Sigil; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Republic Med Center. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dantooine, Medical Sublevel, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Emergency Cocktail Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Emergency Cocktail Fractured Ward Sigil.

She ran a trauma ward upstairs for six years. Best hands I ever watched work - and then she decided consent was a bottleneck. Now she guards their mixing room and doses herself from the stock. Whatever speed and strength you're imagining, add more, and remember she knows exactly where you keep your arteries. Professionally.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Emergency Cocktail Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

It marked that room as a protected ward - my predecessor's mark, from when the sublevel still healed people. The crew cracked it when they took the room, then left it hanging on the door like a joke. Bring me the fractured half. I'd rather it sit broken in my drawer than whole on their door.

Defeat the Emergency Cocktail Warden in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Emergency Cocktail Fractured Ward Sigil; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Republic Med Center. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Emergency Cocktail Warden. Let me see the Emergency Cocktail Fractured Ward Sigil.
The warden can no longer protect that school. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four senior staff still authorize the treatments. Take back the matron's token. Defeat four members of the Emergency Cocktail Inner Circle in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Emergency Cocktail Matron's Ward Token; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Republic Med Center.
Your key still grants access to Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Defeat four members of the Emergency Cocktail Inner Circle to secure the Emergency Cocktail Matron's Ward Token, then return to me.

The founders. Two washed out of this facility's certification board, one mixed for a mercenary column, and the fourth - the fourth trained me, years ago, which is a sentence I'd rather you forgot. They built the doctrine the adepts died practicing. Every dose in that ledger traces uphill to those four signatures.

Before this was a facility, it was one ward run by one matron, back when the enclave conduits still hummed. Her token passed hand to hand; whoever held it answered for every patient below. The circle took it because holding it says the sublevel answers to them. I don't run on sentiment, but I make an exception for that piece of brass.

The Emergency Cocktail Inner Circle fight together. Bring help if you can, and focus on one opponent at a time. Defeat four members to secure the Emergency Cocktail Matron's Ward Token; simultaneous kills aren't required.

Defeat four members of the Emergency Cocktail Inner Circle in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Emergency Cocktail Matron's Ward Token; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Republic Med Center.
You've defeated four members of the Emergency Cocktail Inner Circle. Let me see the Emergency Cocktail Matron's Ward Token.
Their senior staff have lost the authority to continue. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master perfected his mixture at the patients' expense. Defeat him in the Protected Ward and stop the experiments. Defeat the Emergency Cocktail Master in Dantooine, Protected Ward. Report back to me here in Dantooine, Republic Med Center; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dantooine, Protected Ward, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Emergency Cocktail Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

An entire recovery wing. Twenty-six beds. He needed subjects at the exact edge of death to tune the timing, so he manufactured the edge. The cocktail works - that's the unbearable part. Every one of those patients stabilized beautifully, right up until he needed the bed for the next iteration. Perfection with a body count. That's what you're ending.

Because I already tried. Years ago, when it was him and me and one shared bench. I ran, he stayed, and everything below that hatch is what staying looks like. My hands still mix a fair cocktail, but they shake when that door comes up in conversation, and shaking hands kill patients. You're my steady hands now. That's the whole confession - don't make me repeat it.

I recommend two companions against the Emergency Cocktail Master. Spread the pressure so one person doesn't have to carry the whole fight. You can enter alone, but prepare carefully before you call the challenge.

Defeat the Emergency Cocktail Master in Dantooine, Protected Ward. Report back to me here in Dantooine, Republic Med Center; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Emergency Cocktail Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The experiments are over. Your patients deserve skilled hands and a choice; remember both. You've earned the right to train Emergency Cocktail. Your final payment is ready.
Back to the job.
I'll defeat six Emergency Cocktail Adepts.
What is an emergency cocktail, exactly?
How do I reach this sublevel?
What's waiting for me down there?
Not today. Find another set of hands.
Here's the Emergency Cocktail Triage Ward Ledger.
Back to the specialists.
I'll defeat five Emergency Cocktail Specialists.
What makes a specialist worse than an adept?
Why does the coupler matter so much?
How rough will it get down there this time?
My kit's empty. I'll come back restocked.
Here's the Emergency Cocktail Kolto Conduit Coupler.
Back to the warden.
I'll defeat the Emergency Cocktail Warden.
Who is this warden?
Would you recommend bringing help?
What's the ward sigil to you?
Not until I have the right people beside me.
Here's the Emergency Cocktail Fractured Ward Sigil.
Back to the circle.
I'll defeat four members of the Emergency Cocktail Inner Circle.
Who are these four?
What's the matron's token to the sublevel?
Four at once. What am I walking into?
Let me settle my nerves first.
Here's the Emergency Cocktail Matron's Ward Token.
Back to the master.
I'll face the Emergency Cocktail Master and report back.
What did perfecting it cost him?
Why haven't you gone down there yourself?
How does he fight?
Not yet. This one deserves my best.
The Emergency Cocktail Master is defeated. Here's my report.
